interpretation: Current generalized gate-only debug has up/down fallback as batch_env_missing + one_name_filter because down batch is not enabled.
Gate8/down4 Q80 split debug activates the MXFP4 down Q8_0-compatible batch path; fallback CSV then contains only up with batch_unsupported + one_name_filter.

Expanding GGML_MOE_STREAM_ONE_NAME_FILTER to ffn_gate_exps,ffn_up_exps can eliminate fallback rows when paired with down Q80 batch, proving a prompt-general all-GPU expert route is reachable with existing code.
The all-GPU filter-both route is slower: one8/down4, one10/down2, and one12/down1 all produce only 1.9 tok/s on n64 France despite correctness_ok=true and strict RAM OK.
one13/down4 exceeds practical VRAM headroom: down batch cache falls back to 0.2GiB and the run aborts with CUDA OOM.

Therefore simply adding up to the existing one-stream cache is not a SOTA route. The next implementation should build a separate up-aware source/cache strategy or a correctness-checked retained/fused explicit dataflow that does not evict gate/down working sets.
